messages:
derek_sec: Heads-up — after the KMS rotation last night I saw a route that should only accept `embeddings:read` being allowed by a legacy service token with `chat:complete` scope. Repro steps below, looks like inheritance/metadata stuck.

kms-bot: Key rewrap completed 2024-11-17T02:11Z for kms-key-prod-42 (rotation_id: r-20241117-02)

alice.chen: Oof. Do we have an example token id and offending route?

derek_sec: Token: svc-legacy-09a3, route: /v1/chat/completions (model pinned to text-embedding-3-small on the route config), logs show authz allowed. Snippet:

```
2024-11-17T02:13:01Z authz: token=svc-legacy-09a3 route=/v1/chat/completions model=text-embedding-3-small action=allow reason=scope-match:embeddings:read
```

ben.j: Wait that log says scope-match:embeddings:read but action=allow for chat endpoint. That implies per-route enforcement matched embedding scope but we still returned allow. Is the enforcement logic checking per-model vs per-route scopes separately?

carol_ops: Could be the per-route mapping code path that maps model->capability uses a legacy map that treats embedding-models as both chat+embed. We recently merged a small refactor in authz-service:authz/refactor-allowed-models last week.

alice.chen: I can repro locally if someone can share an obfuscated copy of svc-legacy-09a3 header and the route config. Derek, do you have the record from the audit log?

derek_sec: Pasted redacted header and route config below:

```
Authorization: Bearer svc-****-09a3
Route config: { "path": "/v1/chat/completions", "allowed_models": ["text-embedding-3-small"], "require_scope": "embeddings:read" }
```

kms-bot: Note: During rotation we briefly had mixed metadata in kms-meta-cache: some entries still referenced old key-tag service-token-legacy: true for a short window.

ben.j: That could explain sticky metadata. If authz cache keyed off key-tag and service tokens got re-tagged incorrectly, they might pick up legacy flags that bypass per-route checks.

carol_ops: Quick mitigation: disable legacy fallback in authz layer for service tokens until we confirm. There's a feature flag authz.legacy_fallback that can be toggled.

derek_sec: Good. I flipped authz.legacy_fallback=false in staging and prod-3 (low impact) at 02:28Z. Monitoring traces now.

alice.chen: Reproduced locally with the refactor branch: when key metadata contains {legacy:true} we short-circuit to permissive-mode which maps embeddings->chat for backward compat. That's the bug.

ben.j: Root cause summary: KMS rotation + transient cache rewrap left stale legacy metadata on tokens. Authz fallback logic intentionally permissive for legacy tokens, and the recent refactor moved the permissive-path before per-route enforcement.

derek_sec: Impact: tokens with legacy flag could access mismatched endpoints (embedding tokens hitting chat and vice versa). Customer-facing? No direct report yet, we throttled logs to check. Potentially low volume (legacy svc tokens only), but severity = high for policy correctness.

carol_ops: Actions:
- rollback merge that reordered checks (PR #4281) OR patch order to run per-route enforcement before legacy fallback (short-term)
- invalidate kms-meta-cache entries produced during rotation window (immediate)
- add regression test: token with legacy flag must still be subject to per-route require_scope
- add alert when authz decision is permissive and route.scope != token.scope

alice.chen: I'll open a patch that reorders checks and include unit+integration tests. ETA 2 hrs for patch & canary.

ben.j: I'll run a one-off job to purge kms-meta-cache keys with rotation_id=r-20241117-02 across all regions, and add a TTL-safe invalidation.

kms-bot: Invalidation job queued: invalidate-meta r-20241117-02 -> started 2024-11-17T03:05Z, targets: us-west1, eu-west2, ap-southeast1

derek_sec: Oncall note: create incident if any public API returns 403->200 regressions or unusual spike in cross-surface calls. For now keep quiet until confirmed.

carol_ops: Follow-ups for next sprint: audit all legacy_fallback code paths, add e2e in staging that rotates keys and runs authz assertions, and add KMS rotation telemetry linking to authz decisions.

alice.chen: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/authz/pulls/4293 (patch + tests). Request review from @ben.j @derek_sec

ben.j: Reviewing now. Also add an alert: authz_decision == \"allow\" && token.scopes ∩ route.required_scopes == ∅ -> fire high-priority.

derek_sec: Thanks. I'll prepare a postmortem stub and assign owner to security-triage for next week. Marking participants: @alice.chen (fix), @ben.j (cache purge), @carol_ops (rollback/ops), @derek_sec (incident lead).

kms-bot: Invalidation completed for us-west1/eu-west2; ap-southeast1 pending (3m)

carol_ops: Confirmed on prod-3 after flag flip: no further logs of chat endpoint allowing embedding-only tokens. Monitoring 15m.

derek_sec: Closing thread for now. We'll reopen if postmortem finds more fallout. Thanks all :thumbsup:
